rca of the issue: No bugs in iter34. One non-issue noted during testing: when forcing localStorage to a non-default order then reloading, the reorder was reflected in the localStorage value but the rendered DOM y-coords looked overlapping in headless playwright (likely due to grid layout collapsing during reflow). The reset path conclusively restores default order (summary y=252 < workflows y=479 < inbox y=768) and clears the localStorage key, so persistence + reset are both functional.
